chapters.label: Live: Brasília 2008
chapters.text: Brasília, 2008: the World Cup, at home in Brazil. Brazil play Russia. Their pivot, Lenísio, scores twice, and Brazil win seven nil!

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: His famous move is the quick finish. Here’s how he does it. The pass comes into the box, and he shoots first time, low, before the keeper is ready!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The keeper is still moving across. The ball is already past him.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn. Shoot early in the box, because futsal keepers have less time to react!
